run_time_in_zone_analysis: run the main function to calculate object dwell time in polygon zones from a video file with a Roboflow model
create_polygon_zones: create PolygonZone instances from zone configuration polygons with CENTER triggering anchor for detection zone entry
build_byte_tracker: build a ByteTrack tracker with configurable matching threshold to maintain object IDs across video frames
annotate_detections_with_labels: annotate video frames with ColorAnnotator and LabelAnnotator showing tracker IDs and formatted time-in-zone
test_fps_timer_tick: test FPSBasedTimer.tick method to compute dwell time for detections currently inside a polygon zone
